newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK seven-yr notes average accepted yield 7.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK seven-yr notes average accepted yield 7.12 pct.

text.p: The average accepted price for seven-year Exchange Fund Notes tendered on Monday was 99.68 to yield 7.12 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority said.
This compares with a price of 99.48 and a yield of 6.66 percent at the last tender, the HKMA said.
Bids for the HK$500 million issue were HK$1.3 billion down from HK$3.98 billion at the last tender.
The lowest price accepted was 99.64 for a yield of 7.13 percent while the average price tendered was 99.62 for a yield of 7.13 percent, the HKMA said.
The notes carry a coupon of 6.94 percent and mature on May 27, 2004.
